stem: In the selection “DO Look Down!,” the author includes the photographs and their captions most likely to highlight which idea?

options.label: A
options.text: It took several years to construct the Grand Canyon Skywalk.

options.label: B
options.text: The Grand Canyon Skywalk is attached to the entrance building.

options.label: C
options.text: The Grand Canyon Skywalk brings visitors to Grand Canyon West.

options.label: D
options.text: Building the Grand Canyon Skywalk required the agreement of tribal elders.
